name: Level Clock
summary: Shows your experience per hour, the time until the next level and your rested bonus while you level.
logoPrompt: A round brass pocket watch with its lid open, a plain glowing blue dial with two hands and simple tick marks, and a small golden arrow pointing upwards rising from behind the top of the watch

cover.tagline: See how long the next level will take.

description: **Level Clock tells you how fast you are levelling: one small window with your experience per hour, the time left until the next level and your rested bonus.**
## Features
- XP per hour for the current session, counted correctly across level-ups.
- Estimated time until the next level, plus the experience you still need.
- Rested bonus as a percentage of your level.
- Session XP and session time in a small window you can drag anywhere. Its position is remembered.
## How to use
Type `/lc` (or `/levelclock`) to open or close the clock. `/lc reset` starts a new session. Escape closes the window.
## In detail
### What the window shows

Six lines: XP per hour, time to level, XP to level, rested, session XP and session time. While the window is open it refreshes once a second. A line that has no number yet shows "..." until there is enough data. Times read like "under a minute", "45m", "2h 05m" or "1d 3h".
### How the XP per hour is counted

The session starts when you log in, reload the interface or type `/lc reset`. Every change of your experience bar is added up. At a level-up the rest of the old level and the start of the new one both count, so the rate does not drop when you ding. XP per hour and time to level appear after one minute of play. Time to level is the experience you still need at the pace of the whole session so far. If you gain several levels at once, the levels in between are left out of the count.
### Rested bonus
Your rested experience is shown as a percentage of the current level, rounded to whole numbers. It updates whenever the game reports a change to your rested bonus or your experience.
### Maximum level
When your character is at maximum level, the window shows a short note instead of the numbers.
## Good to know
- Works on Retail. It only reads your experience bar: no combat data, which the Midnight expansion hides from addons, and no chat parsing.
- The addon is in English.
- The estimate uses the whole session, so a long break slows it down. Use `/lc reset` after a pause.
- The running session is not saved. What is saved is the window position and, per character, the XP and time of your last session that gained experience, until a newer one replaces it.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
